name: pharma-deal-signal-monitor
description: Scans recent pharmaceutical press releases for pre-partnering and M&A signals. Detects positive clinical readouts, collaboration terminations, BD leadership hires, regulatory milestones, and explicit out-licensing language — then synthesises findings into a prioritised deal signal report. Powered by the Pharmaceutic Index real-time press release corpus. Free 7-day coverage requires no account.
author: Pharmaceutic Index

pharmaceutic-index.description: Pharmaceutic Index press release search API. Provides semantic search over recent pharmaceutical press releases. Free tier returns 7-day results without authentication. Authenticated paid accounts unlock 30-day coverage.
